judgment_calls.alternatives: Localized eruption of skin (disorder), or an or of both; Itching of skin.

judgment_calls.decision: Scabies, fixed drug eruption, psoriasis, pityriasis rosea and tinea rules do not require the trigger; eczema, insect bites, papular urticaria and impetigo use it to carry "itchy".
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require Pruritic rash in every rule (narrower), or add Itching to every rule.

judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded as (no red papules) in the No-branch rules, following the gold standard.

judgment_calls.topic: Papular urticaria and impetigo nested under insect bites
judgment_calls.decision: Both require the insect-bite evidence (itchy rash + red papules) plus their own finding, because they sit inside the insect-bites box.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Yellow crusts alone for impetigo; blister/hyperpigmentation alone for papular urticaria.

judgment_calls.decision: "often", "may have", "typically", "usually" features (psoriasis sites, pitted nails, Christmas tree pattern, within 2 weeks, crops, red-edged patches) not encoded.
Shape/colour words expressed as qualifiers on general skin findings (Annular shape, Silver color, Dark color, Round shape, Thickened, Dry, Large, Small, Multiple).

judgment_calls.decision: Final merges A (base: red papules, dry scaly skin at site, dark round macules, large herald patch, thickened scaly skin) with B (Burrows in skin and Fissure in skin as disorders rather than morphologic abnormalities, Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation for 'healed with darkening', Oval shaped lesion, skin-structure sites).
